property.name: javax.jdo.option.ConnectionURL
property.description: NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES works around a real bug: Hive 3.1.3's bundled DataNucleus generates `LIKE '...' ESCAPE '\'` with an unescaped raw backslash, which is invalid under MariaDB's default string-literal parsing (backslash is the escape character there by default). This breaks partitioned-table operations (labs/05) without the workaround.

property.name: javax.jdo.option.ConnectionPassword
property.description: Educational lab credential only, not exposed outside the container.

property.name: hive.stats.autogather
property.description: Hive 3.1.3's DataNucleus (4.1.x) can't map the auto-generated column stats "bitVector" BLOB field against this MariaDB version (JDOFatalInternalException on INSERT ... PARTITION). Auto stats gathering isn't needed for this course; students who want stats can run ANALYZE TABLE explicitly.
